'''Bill Packer Convert Vader Control Endor''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Bill Packer]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-15566">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15566 Convert Vader  Control Endor], DeckTech (Bill "Whipping Boy" packer, 24 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15566/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15566/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Bill Packer]]
* '''Published:''' 24 April 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Convert Vader  Control Endor''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif|label=There Is Good In Him}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 TIGIH Packer LS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' Basically, while Luke is free, have fun on Endor. If he's captured by an Imp, they lose 2 a turn, and have fun on Endor. If it's Vader who captured Luke, start winning battles on Endor and try to convert Vader

== Original post ==

'''Convert Vader  Control Endor'''
* '''Author:''' Bill "Whipping Boy" packer
* '''Published:''' April 24, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 3.0
* '''Description:''' Basically, while Luke is free, have fun on Endor. If he's captured by an Imp, they lose 2 a turn, and have fun on Endor. If it's Vader who captured Luke, start winning battles on Endor and try to convert Vader

=== Strategy ===

This is a deck that has sort of worked for me. but since i've never done a sanctioned tournament, i don't really know. i try to convert Vader. If no Vader is around, then the dark side loses force, i drain on Endor, and if i feel lucky, maybe play in the asteroids with the A-wings. The space and ground have good scrapping power, so if all else fails...anyways, i love constructive criticism, so any and all suggestions are appreciated
